question: Should Codex app-server workspace-write turns become network-enabled by default, or should network access remain denied unless maintainers add an explicit opt-in path?
rationale: The diff changes a sandbox network boundary for existing users, and source inspection can identify the risk but cannot decide whether maintainers want that product/security default.

options.title: Keep Default Denied
options.body: Restore workspace-write networkAccess false and handle any needed connectivity through an explicit, documented opt-in path.

options.title: Approve New Default
options.body: Accept network-enabled workspace-write app-server turns as intentional, with security review, upgrade notes, and real proof.

options.title: Split The Bundle
options.body: Separate the TUI/browser/auth fixes from the sandbox-default change so narrower repairs can move while the security decision stays pending.

recommendation.title: Keep Default Denied
